content:
In the realm of healthcare, expertise and compassion intertwine to form the foundation of exceptional patient care. At Praanavaidya Hospital, our esteemed medical team embodies this ethos, bringing together diverse backgrounds and specialized knowledge to offer integrated medical solutions. From Ayurveda’s ancient wisdom to modern surgical advancements, each practitioner is driven by a deep-seated commitment to healing and holistic well-being. Let’s delve into the personal journeys and professional expertise of the dedicated individuals who comprise our medical family.

 

Doctor Name: Dr. Chetan Upadhyaya

Qualification: MS (Ayu), FAGE

Department: Dept. of Shalya Tantra (Surgery)

Experience: 6 years

Dr. Chetan Upadhyaya is an accomplished Ayurvedic surgeon specializing in surgical and para-surgical procedures. His journey into Shalya Tantra (surgery) was sparked by a life-changing experience witnessing the impact of surgical intervention on a loved one. Driven by a passion for precision and healing, he integrates Ayurvedic principles with modern surgical techniques to provide transformative care for his patients.

Dr. Chetan Upadhyaya’s journey into Shalya Tantra (surgery) was sparked by witnessing a life-saving operation on a family member, igniting his passion for healing through precise medical interventions. This firsthand experience of surgery’s profound impact on patients inspired his specialization in this transformative field.

 

Doctor Name: Dr. Pramod Karanth

Qualification: BAMS, MD (Ayu)

Department: Dept. of Kayachikitsa

Experience: 4 years

Are you seeking effective, natural solutions rooted in Ayurveda for chronic illnesses and lifestyle concerns?

Meet Dr. Pramod Karanth, a distinguished Ayurvedic consultant renowned for his mastery of traditional Ayurvedic methods. Inspired by Ayurveda’s holistic healing principles, Dr. Karanth blends ancient wisdom with modern science to address a wide spectrum of health challenges. His journey is marked by a profound dedication to promoting wellness and restoring health through personalized Ayurvedic treatments.

Dr. Pramod Karanth draws inspiration from Ayurveda’s holistic healing principles and a profound dedication to natural medicine, choosing to integrate ancient wisdom with modern science in patient care. His journey exemplifies a steadfast commitment to enhancing wellness and rejuvenating health through tailored, traditional Ayurvedic therapies.

 

Doctor Name: Dr. Swasthika

Qualification: BAMS, MD (Ayu)

Department: Dept. of Kayachikitsa

Experience: 5 years

With a passion for holistic healing and a commitment to preserving the heritage of Ayurvedic medicine, Dr. Swasthika specializes in Kayachikitsa. Her expertise lies in treating chronic diseases and lifestyle disorders using comprehensive Ayurvedic approaches. Driven by personal experiences of Ayurveda’s transformative effects, she embarked on a career to make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives through integrated, holistic healthcare solutions.

Dr. Swasthika, specializing in Kayachikitsa, was drawn to Ayurveda by a deep personal connection to holistic healing and traditional medicine. Inspired by the transformative impact of Ayurveda in her family and community, she pursued a career integrating ancient wisdom with modern practices.

 

Doctor Name: Dr. Pradeep Kumar N

Qualification: MBBS, DNB (Gen Surgery), DNB (Plastic Surgery), MBA

Department: Dept. of Allopathy Medicine

Experience: 9 years

Dr. Pradeep Kumar N is a versatile expert in plastic and cosmetic surgery, complemented by an MBA. His journey began with a childhood dream of becoming a surgeon, fuelled by a desire to make a lasting difference in people’s lives through advanced medical interventions. With a focus on debunking myths and ensuring patient safety, Dr. Pradeep Kumar N leads the Department of Allopathy Medicine with dedication and expertise.

 

Doctor Name: Dr. Pradeep S J

Qualification: MBBS | Consultant Family Physician

Department: Dept. of Allopathy Medicine

Experience: 9 years

As a compassionate family physician, Dr. Pradeep S. J. provides comprehensive healthcare with a focus on primary care and wellness. His career in Allopathy Medicine is driven by a deep-seated passion to serve humanity and improve patient outcomes through personalized healthcare solutions. Dr. Pradeep S J’s commitment to compassionate care underscores his dedication to enhancing the quality of life for individuals of all ages.

Conclusion

At Praanavaidya Hospital, our medical team stands as a testament to the power of integrated medicine and compassionate care. Each member brings unique qualifications, experiences, and personal stories that enrich our holistic approach to healthcare. Whether you seek Ayurvedic wisdom, surgical expertise, or modern medical interventions, our team is dedicated to guiding you on your journey to health and wellness.

Discover the difference at Praanavaidya, where expertise meets empathy and healing begins with understanding. Join us in celebrating our medical experts, who are transforming lives every day with their unwavering dedication and commitment to excellence in healthcare.

This article not only introduces the esteemed medical team at Praanavaidya Hospital but also highlights their journeys, expertise, and dedication to patient care. It aims to resonate with professionals seeking integrated healthcare solutions and inspire confidence in the comprehensive services offered by Praanavaidya’s medical specialists.
